title: The Submerged Continents of Atlantis and Lemuria (Cosmic Memory)
author: Rudolf Steiner
description: The Submerged Continents of Atlantis and Lemuria: Their History and Civilization, Being Chapters from the Akashic Records by Rudolf Steiner, Ph.D. (Vienna), in the authorised early English translation (1911). Originally published as essays in Steiner's journal Lucifer-Gnosis (1904-08) and later known as Cosmic Memory, it presents Steiner's clairvoyant reading of the Akashic Record on humanity's prehistory. He describes the Atlantean epoch with its seven sub-races, its use of life force, its leaders and initiates and its catastrophic end, and the earlier Lemurian age, the separation of the sexes, the development of the human body and soul faculties, and the cosmic stages of Earth's evolution through Saturn, Sun and Moon conditions. Written while Steiner led the German Theosophical Society, it is foundational for anthroposophical cosmology and parallels Blavatsky's Secret Doctrine.
